name: Standing Single-leg Hinge
summary: Balancing on one leg, the body tips forward as one long line while the free leg lifts behind. Three versions: straight forward, tipped to the side, and with a twist.
steps: Stand tall on one leg, the other toe resting behind.
Breathe in to tip forward from the hip, the back leg lifting as the chest lowers.
Breathe out to return to upright.

layers.title: Side
layers.text: Tip sideways, lifting the leg out to the side.

layers.title: With rotation
layers.text: At the bottom, turn the chest open and closed.

layers.title: Add arms or weights
layers.text: Reach forward or hold hand weights.

modifications: Fingertips on a wall or chair.
cues:
Head to heel stays one line, like a seesaw.
Hips stay level and square.
Soft standing knee.
